headline: Value Industries Limited: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process — 62nd CoC Meeting
sum: Value Industries Limited has initiated a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, with the 62nd Committee of Creditors meeting scheduled for 23 June 2026 to progress the resolution plan.
detail: Value Industries Limited has notified the NSE of a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The 62nd meeting of the Committee of Creditors (CoC) was scheduled for 23 June 2026. The intimation was filed on 22 June 2026, indicating an active resolution process at an advanced stage of creditor deliberations. The specific details of claims, liabilities, or bidders remain undisclosed in the public filing.
